title: Article 5 — Temporary stay of foreign citizens (Federal Law 115-FZ, current text)
note: Supports the current 90-calendar-day fingerprint/photo rule for non-work stays over 90 days, the 30-calendar-day medical-examination rule after the 2026 amendment, repeat-examination timing, and consequences for non-compliance.

title: Articles 20–22 — Migration registration at the place of stay (Federal Law 109-FZ, current text)
note: Supports the place-of-stay registration model, receiving-party duties, foreign-citizen filing cases, confirmation via the detachable notification part, and the rule that the receiving party may not seize the foreign citizen's identity/migration documents.

title: Federal Law No. 162-FZ of 10 June 2026
